perspectives.title: State Pension Reform
perspectives.summary: State pension should be increased for low-income earners

representative_posts.author: voxlibero.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It would have been far more acceptable if it had been accompanied by a reduction in tax relief on pension contributions for those earning high salaries (say £250k+) which funded an increase in the state pension for those with annual (pension) incomes below minimum wage. bsky.app/profile/voxl...

representative_posts.author: mancalled.horse
representative_posts.text: I think state pension should be tied to real living wage (breaking the triple lock but not in a way to make the welfare budget cutters happy)

representative_posts.author: mosltlylurking.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The only thing you talked about I expect him to go through with is ditching the pension triple lock, increasing poverty for the elderly. He can't do anything about brexit and won't do anything about fptp.

representative_posts.author: aandrkerr.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: We need the triple lock because for some pensioners that's all they get and it's miserly. Obviously those with big workplace pensions don't need it - how about taking some tax relief away from the more luxurious pension schemes and protecting the triple lock?

representative_posts.author: townsquare.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think this is the trade-off for setting up a National Care Service and finally helping address Social Care. 😍🤩 Also UK currently has one of the lowest state pensions in the OECD.

representative_posts.author: laotianrockrat.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm afraid you are. There's no annuity involved, what you receive comes from national insurance paid by people now working the same way your contributions paid towards the pension of the previous generation. There's no shame in it

representative_posts.author: rogerb1940.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Some pensioners are very wealthy! There are some in receipt of ‘final salary level’ pensions & there are others who’ve benefitted from huge ‘pension pots’ built up as a tax avoidance ruse! They should all be taxed a great deal more; so that many more of the poorest are taken out of tax altogether!

representative_posts.author: aiteall.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Make poor pensioners pay: Blairite Labour, Tory and Reform.

representative_posts.author: hugan.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: That's par for the course for centrists Dan. See also: triple lock for pensions. Highlight the small number of high-value targets, push through the policy, and ignore the substantial collateral damage.

representative_posts.author: pete11.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Does that mean that Sept 2029 CPI & Avg Earnings values are set for 2030/31 year and the start of Triple Lock 2.0? For pensions planning it would be prudent to use a 2.5% increase taking anything more as a bonus? Year-by-years figures for each variable would make it easier

representative_posts.author: sunderlandlolly.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Means testing is a slippery slope to nothing. We were told increasing the pension age would protect it. Now it's unsustainable again. Its a race to the bottom.

representative_posts.author: marianneh.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I do sometimes wonder what will happen to civic society when their generation and their decent occupational pensions are no longer around. They are in their mid seventies, have been 'retired' for over a decade, and are just hitting the point where medical issues are slowing them down a bit.

arguments: Increase state pension for low-income earners by reducing tax relief on high earners' pension contributions
Tie state pension to real living wage to help low-income pensioners
Increase state pension to address poverty among elderly
